No deprecated expo packages detected in migrated screens. No invisible-text / contrast issues observed in dark or light theme.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError 'can\'t compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' at /app/backend/reviews_score_crm.py:385. `cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is tz-aware but `p.get('updated_at')` from Mongo is tz-naive. Repeated in logs 7+ times. Pages /agent-score and /agent-dashboard surface a console 500 (UI still renders fallback). Fix: coerce `u = u.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if u.tzinfo is None else u` before the >= comparison.

Example: `u = u.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if (isinstance(u, datetime) and u.tzinfo is None) else u` then compare. This currently prints two 500 tracebacks whenever /agent-score or /agent-dashboard loads.

critical_code_review_comments: reviews_score_crm.py:385 — comparing a tz-aware `cutoff` to a possibly tz-naive mongo datetime is a known Python 3 pitfall. The project uses tz-aware timestamps elsewhere; the fix is centralising a `_to_utc(dt)` helper and using it anywhere a mongo datetime is read.
unlocks.tsx — mapping over the ledger without key={tx.id} will cause index-based reconciliation when items reorder. Not a crash but can produce blink/flicker on real-time wallet updates.

rca_of_issue: Backend /api/agent/score 500 — RCA: `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` returns a tz-aware instant; MongoDB bson stores datetimes without tzinfo (returns tz-naive). Python forbids `aware >= naive` and raises TypeError. Reproduction: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <demo_jwt>' https://property-os-africa.preview.emergentagent.com/api/agent/score. Mitigation: either (a) at read time: `u = u.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if isinstance(u, datetime) and u.tzinfo is None else u`, or (b) at write time: ensure all `updated_at` fields are written as tz-aware (datetime.now(timezone.utc)) and migrate existing naive rows. Option (a) is a 1-line fix and backward-safe.
